BEH-public-web-crawlable.promise: Visitors and crawlers can read and navigate the intended public pages without client JavaScript.
BEH-public-web-crawlable.trigger: ZEN-228: Eduardo approved fixing all audit findings on 2026-10-07.
preconditions: Candidate built from feature/ZEN-228; fresh unauthenticated browser.
expected: Public content is visible with meaningful headings and ordinary navigation links.
Crawler policies, content types, canonical URLs and real error statuses match the environment; revision readback identifies the candidate.
Both languages are real readable URLs with equivalent approved content and consistent metadata.
failure_modes: Hidden no-JS content or navigation without href.
Crawling private pages or publishing misleading metadata.
HTML app shells served as crawler files or unknown assets.
invariants: No authorization, consent, CSP or private-data boundary weakened.
Production and provider indexing proof are not inferred from dev.

validation.entry: Candidate static export using isolated loopback verification or authorized dev origin.
setup: Use only generated candidate assets and fresh browser contexts.

checks.do: Open the built candidate in a fresh browser, with and without JavaScript.
checks.expect: Public content is visible with meaningful headings and ordinary navigation links.

checks.do: Fetch robots, sitemap, known direct routes and an unknown path.
checks.expect: Crawler policies, content types, canonical URLs and real error statuses match the environment; revision readback identifies the candidate.

checks.do: Open both public languages, navigate legal/information links and compare metadata before/after hydration.
checks.expect: Both languages are real readable URLs with equivalent approved content and consistent metadata.

adversarial: Disable JavaScript and request routes directly.
Request an unknown URL and crawler files.
Switch locale and use keyboard navigation.

last_validation.notes: Actual repository zenloth-landing, explicitly hosted under frontend board category due missing enum. Generator followup passes 16 direct browser cases, four keyboard journeys, eight dev-export HTTP/policy probes and seven tests. Locale-correct internal, app and legal destinations persist across repeat builds; dev export clears stale files and keeps preview destinations in dev. Frontend target availability is required before landing merge; live deployment and production/provider proof remain separate.

BEH-landing-reachable-story.promise: Visitors can reach all story content and actions through ordinary scrolling when the viewport cannot accommodate the cinema.
BEH-landing-reachable-story.trigger: ZEN-227: implementation plan accepted by user on 2026-10-07.
preconditions: Fresh anonymous browser on generated development candidate.
expected: Complete hero actions and all story content can be reached without clipping or automatic snap-back.
Layout switches without losing the visible scene or focus; every preview remains reachable.
failure_modes: Multiple animation loops or scroll snapping in normal-flow mode.
Phone previews frozen on the first slide.
invariants: Preserve approved copy, prices, consent and real EN/ES URLs.

validation.entry: Temporary static server for the isolated checkout, / and /en/.
setup: npm ci && npm run build; fresh browser context; record exact viewport, browser and revision.

checks.do: Open / and /en/ at 812x375 and 568x320, dismiss consent, and scroll from hero through every scene.
checks.expect: Complete hero actions and all story content can be reached without clipping or automatic snap-back.

checks.do: Rotate between short landscape and portrait, toggle reduced motion, and navigate all four phone previews.
checks.expect: Layout switches without losing the visible scene or focus; every preview remains reachable.

adversarial: Use keyboard navigation, reduced motion and first-visit/dismissed consent in both locales.

last_validation.notes: Local Chromium/WebKit 38-state contracts passed, including motion/preview focus, slide selection and outside pointer dismissal; evidence on ZEN-227 comments 605, 611 and 613. Formal publication/sealing remains blocked by board HTTP 400 rejecting zenloth-landing. No repo alias or invented ID.
